title: Cork could be thicker for more absorbency.
text: Cork could be thicker for more absorbency.. The cork should be a little thicker so it would be more absorbent.  Too lightweight...sticks to wet glass when you pick up the glass.

product_metadata.title: 4" Cork Coasters, Round Cork & Plastic Plant Saucers for Gardening, Cork trivets for hot pots and Pans, Absorbent Cork mat for Wine, Coffee & Drinks, Cork Board for DIY Craft Supplies (Set of 2)
features: GOOD QUALITY - These plant saucer is made of cork with good quality. Non-toxic materials is suitable for your plants and flowers. With the waterproof plastic bottom, our cork plant saucer can keep liquid rings off of the floor or table. Also, due to the support of these quality mats, the movement will not scratch your floor and furniture.

MULTIFUNCTIONAL - Due to the great water absorbent, our cork mat is not only perfect for plants, but also can be used as cork coaster or bar mat for mugs and glasses. It’s an ideal helper which can protect your home table, suit for kitchen, garden, canteen, bar, courtyard, balcony, and other places.
SIMPLE DESIGN - These cork mats come with simple design. The natural colour brings a good decorative effect and easy to match every decor. Gives a traditional minimalist flavor to your place.
DIY PROJECT - The natural colour and design of the cork mat is suitable for you to create an unique mat according to your own ideas. Spend some fun DIY time with your families and friends!
WHAT YOU GET - You will get 2 pieces of cork pads in 1 package, each is about 4 inches in diameter. Extremely high-quantity cork mats meet your daily replacement and different use needs.
